training.title: Incompany Training
training.description: We teach teams in any department to build their own AI products. From zero to hero in two weeks, inside your company.
training.heroHeading: What used to wait on IT now starts in <u>your team.</u>
training.heroLead: Legal, compliance, engineering, operations and marketing stop requesting products and start creating them. AI in the process, human intelligence in command.
training.heroCta: I want this for my team

app.label: live, in the hands of the people who use it

queue.label: the team does not wait for the next one

training.learnHeading: Better to learn than to <u>keep buying.</u>
training.learnLead: A bought product clears one request. A trained team clears the next one, and the one after that.
training.buyOutcome: The request comes back. So does the queue.
training.learnOutcome: The capability stays. The next module belongs to the team.

buySteps.title: A request
buySteps.body: A brief. A ticket. A department asking.

buySteps.title: A queue
buySteps.body: IT, marketing or a vendor. Waiting.

buySteps.title: One product
buySteps.body: It solves that request. Only that one.

buySteps.title: Again
buySteps.body: The next idea starts from zero.

learnSteps.title: The team
learnSteps.body: The people who live the problem enter the lab.

learnSteps.title: Autonomy
learnSteps.body: A live application and the range to keep creating.

learnSteps.title: The next one
learnSteps.body: The following module is born in the department itself.

training.shiftHeading: One door before. Now every department builds its own module.
training.beforeBody: A ticket to IT. A queue in marketing. A brief that waits. The internal product lived on the other side of the house.
training.afterBody: Each team gains the range to create. Legal builds its own. Compliance builds its own. Engineering builds its own. The company no longer has a single door.
training.whoHeading: From teams born AI first to groups already operating at scale.
training.whoStartupsTitle: Companies that want to be born AI first
training.whoStartupsBody: Lean teams with product superpowers from day one. No waiting on a technology department to validate the next idea.
training.whoEnterpriseBody: At the scale of Volvo, CNH and Neodent. Entire departments with autonomy to create internal applications, without crossing the building for every request.
training.modulesHeading: From the first product to a system that talks to the company.
training.basicBody: Incompany, hands on. The team leaves zero and ships a real internal product: idea, flow, interface and an AI application that solves a live problem in the department.
basicItems: Discovery of the problem in the team's own context
An AI application ready to use
A team ready to build the next module
training.advancedBody: For teams already building who need to go beyond the prototype. Services with databases, name recognition and language intent. The product starts to understand what people ask for and to keep what the company already knows.
advancedItems: Modules that talk to each other
training.method1Body: We go to the team. The lab is the real context, not a generic course.
training.method2Body: Not slides. A live application in the hands of the people who will use it.
training.method3Body: Each department gains the range to keep going on its own. Matilha opens the door. The team walks through.
training.timelineHeading: The team arrives without a product. It leaves with one live.
training.timelineLead: An incompany lab, a real problem, a working application at the end. Then teams already building go deeper into language and data.

steps.title: Immersion in the department
steps.body: The real problem, in the real context. Legal, operations, marketing: the lab is the team itself.

steps.title: Designing the module
steps.body: Flow, experience and what the AI will do. The team defines the product it will build.

steps.title: Hands on
steps.body: The application takes shape. Interface, intelligence and a flow that solves the daily demand.

steps.title: Product in their hands
steps.body: Not slides. A live tool, used by the people who asked for it. The team already has the range for the next module.

steps.title: Language and data
steps.body: Teams already building go further: databases, names, entities and language intent. The product starts talking to the company.

training.ctaHeading: Which department in your company is still waiting in line?
training.ctaBody: Tell us the problem. We assemble the right module for your team.
training.ctaFormulaNote: The capability stays in the department. The next module does not have to cross the building.
